newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Shandong Lukang plans 80 mln A shares IPO.
newsitem.headline: China's Shandong Lukang plans 80 mln A shares IPO.

text.p: China's Shandong Lukang Pharmaceutical Co Ltd will launch an initial public offering of 80 million A shares in the near future and list the stock on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange, a company spokesman said on Tuesday.
The offer, which has been approved by the China Securities Regulatory Commission, would be priced at a minimum of six yuan per share, he told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
China Guotai Securities Co Ltd has been named as the issue's lead underwriter, the official said.
Lukang, based in the city of Jining in eastern Shandong province, produce penicillin and some pharmaceutical raw materials.
Lukang aims to use money raised from the offer to construct a plant designed to produce 1,000 tonnes of penicillin annually, the official said.
The company's products are marketed across China and are also exported to more than 30 countries in Europe, America and Africa, he said.
He gave no other details on the firm.
